versions.name: Camp Little Lemhi
versions.summary: A Grand Teton Council camp property in Yeaman Creek Canyon below Palisades Dam, on the South Fork of the Snake River in eastern Idaho, offering a lodge, a private lake, and forested surroundings for troop camping and outdoor recreation.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified from the Grand Teton Council's own properties/rentals page, which currently lists Little Lemhi as a council camp available for use. Council confirmed as Grand Teton (matches the source hint). The council suspended full resident-camp operations in 2020; the property remains a council-offered camp for troop use and rentals, so classified active as a short-term camp. Coordinates from scout-camp-map, approximate; elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add: existence, council, and current availability verified against the council's own rentals page; camp_type/program_types classified conservatively as a short-term/troop-camping property; features unsurveyed.
